senses.gloss: ch. sameto be suspended. Part. pl. דַּלְיָין suspended.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 1:6">Targ. Esth. I, 6</cite>.

<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 2:19">Targ. Ex. II, 19</cite>. Targ. II Esth. I, 2 buckets <he>דדלו אבנא</he> which draw stone; a. fr. [<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 14:14">Targ. Y. Num. XIV, 14</cite> read <cite ref="M00263"><he>מַדְלֵי</he></cite> Af.] [<cite ref="Pesachim 40a:3">Pes. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>מדלייהו</he>, v. <cite ref="M00304"><he>מַדְלָא</he></cite>.]
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 92b">B. Kam. 92ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="D00838"><he>דַּלְיַת</he></cite>, <he>דְּלִינָא</he>, v. <cite ref="D00351"><he>דּוּרָא</he> IV</cite>.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 18a:13">Ber. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>דַּלְיֵיה</he> (Yalk. Koh. 979; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 152">Yalk. Sam. 152</cite> <he>סלקיה</he>) lift it (the cloak) up.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 81a:11">Kidd. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>דַלְיֵיה וכ׳</he> he carried it by himself.—

<cite ref="Yevamot 92b:2">Yeb. 92ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 17b:3">B. Mets. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>אי לאו דדְלָאִי לך וכ׳</he> had I not taken up (removed) the sherd for thee, thou wouldst never have found the pearl under it, i.e. but for my intimation you would not have reached the conclusion &c.; <cite ref="Makkot 21b">Macc. 21ᵇ</cite>.—

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 32:51">Targ. Y. Deut. XXXII, 51</cite> <he>ולא דַּלּוּ מיניה</he> (Var. <cite ref="D00813"><he>דָּלוּ</he></cite>, fr. <cite ref="D00842"><he>דְּלַל</he></cite>) and they would not relieve him (give him a respite).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 32:51">Ib.</cite> <he>דַּלִּי מיני</he> (Var. <cite ref="D00829"><he>דְּלִי</he></cite>) respite me.—
<cite ref="Megillah 13a:22">Meg. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>דַּלֵּי כרגא</he> he lightened the taxes (<cite ref="Esther 2:18">Esth. II, 18</cite>).
<cite ref="Berakhot 6b:16">Ber. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>דַּלּוּיֵי</he> lifting up the voice at funerals, v. <cite ref="D00842"><he>דְּלַל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Sotah 34a:8">Sot. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>טעונא דמַדְלֵי וכ׳</he> a load which one can lift up and put on his shoulders, is the third portion of the weight he can carry.

senses.gloss: to be suspended. Y. Sabb. XVI, end, 15ᵈ, a. e. בגדך מִדְּלֵי (sub. אַתְּ) doest thou depend on thy good luck?, v. גַּדָּא.

units: <cite ref="Pesachim 8a:9">Pes. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>דמִידַּלְיָא</he> (a bed) which stands on high legs (leaving space under it).

<cite ref="Bava Batra 16b:7">B. Bath. 16ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 106:4">Yalk. Gen. 106</cite> (prov.) (<he>מִידְּלֵי</he>) <he>א׳ יומא א׳ קצירא</he> when the day (sun) is high, the sick man is relieved.
